description.value: The Village Taphouse is a casual pub and restaurant in North Vancouver's Park Royal area, operated by Park Royal Village Tap House Ltd. (affiliated with Cactus Restaurants Ltd.). The menu spans shareable plates, artisan pizzas, burgers, salads, and handhelds, with both indoor seating and an outdoor patio. Online ordering for pickup and delivery is available, making it a flexible food stop.

address.value: 900 Main St, West Vancouver, BC V7T 0A5, Canada
